messages:
Alex K: Handoff — I'm on until 21:45 UTC. Planned non-critical rollout for kv-cache pruning v2 at 21:00 UTC. Canary starts 20:30. Expected impact: short p50 blips during prefix eviction, low probability of client errors. Will leave rollback steps below.

Jen T: Ack. Who's onwatch for canary smoke?

Alex K: @Chandra primary watcher, @Mike L fallback. Jen, can you own telemetry + alert thresholds? :eyes:

Chandra: On it. I'll run the smoke script and watch traces. Will post quick snapshots here every 5–10m. Ping me if you want a manual rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for service=kv-cache component=pruner version=v2-prune at 2026-03-18T20:30:00Z

Mike L: If p50 > 200ms sustained >5m or error rate >0.5%, follow rollback plan A. Rollback plan A:
```
# Rollback Plan A
1) Scale canary down: `kubectl scale deploy kv-cache-pruner-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`
2) Route traffic to stable: `kubectl patch svc kv-cache -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"kv-cache-stable"}}}'`
3) Open rollback PR and notify release channel
```

Sara P: Quick FYI — billing batch runs between 21:00-21:30 UTC (freeze window). Avoid any DB schema or config changes during that window.

Alex K: Good catch, @Sara. Also set paging thresholds: page L2 when p99 > 800ms or errors >1% for 5m. Jen, can you confirm PD rule?

Jen T: Confirmed. Added PD rule and short escalation note. Dashboard link: https://redwood.ops/dash/kv-cache-canary (will be live in ~2m).

Chandra: Starting smoke now. Quick check output: `curl -sS https://canary.kv/health && echo \"OK\"` -> OK. Small token rate spike ~1.2x but tail latency within expected. Posting flamegraph if anything odd.

Mike L: Thanks. I'll stand by as fallback. If we need to abort, call it and I'll run steps.

Alex K: Leaving a note in oncall doc + runbook. Thanks team — I'll be reachable on DM until 21:45. :v:
